## Security verdict: PASS WITH NOTES

PR #167, exact head `2d2f04e592bc405fa958f8954fa86f0a94748cad`.

Reviewed `dc772d6..2d2f04e` and the directly dependent admission, persistence and wake flow. No new high-confidence security exploit or public-privacy regression was identified. The holdings error and post-admission persistence notes are source-repaired; remaining reliability limits are not cleared.

| # | Severity | File | Lines | Vulnerability | Confidence |
|---|----------|------|-------|---------------|------------|
| - | - | - | - | No new vulnerability identified | - |

### Repair and authority evidence

Holdings errors now propagate instead of becoming an empty set (`crates/daemon/src/http/memory_turn.rs:375-395`); the watchdog leaves the pending row unsettled on that error (`crates/daemon/src/compaction_wake.rs:198-212`).

The pending write completes before compact delivery admission. Write failure returns without admitting the compact (`crates/daemon/src/http/mod.rs:2546-2556`). Owned transaction inputs and commit outlive a cancelled waiter (`crates/store/src/compactions.rs:25-47`; `crates/store/src/migrate.rs:43-56`).

Pane-derived actor/process validation occurs before persistence (`http/mod.rs:2466-2516`). The original message target and ID are copied into the owned write, and the same message enters delivery. Receipt lookup uses that seat/message pair. Supersession now requires a delivered newer row for the same seat, not insertion alone (`compaction_wake.rs:78-95,128-158`). No new caller-selected wake author, recipient or body is added.

Existing compact authority and C32 registration-strength limitations remain unchanged. Prior fixed seat/recorded-parent recipients and label-only metadata evidence stand; no wider confidential content or C19/C21 disclosure was introduced.

### Remaining reliability and migration notes

- Cancellation after persistence but before admission can leave a ghost row delaying an older wake until the one-hour cutoff. Reusing the same message ID after that row settles undelivered does not re-arm tracking: insertion ignores the existing settled row (`crates/store/src/compactions.rs:32-45,55-59`; `compaction_wake.rs:149-155`).
- Settlement-before-send gives at-most-once initiation per row, not guaranteed delivery. Cancellation, shutdown, refusal or send failure can still lose the wake without retry (`compaction_wake.rs:104-111,264-325`).
- Migration 0044 changes comments only; the additive DDL is unchanged (`crates/store/migrations/0044_compaction_wakes.sql:1-27`). Its checksum changes still matter to databases migrated by an intermediate unmerged build.

These are correctness/deployment limitations, not demonstrated new authority or confidentiality exploits. A security pass does not certify their closure.

### Proof

GitHub metadata and the independent remote pull ref agree on the reviewed SHA; GitHub reports CLEAN. CI run `42420467930` and latest successful Delivers run `42420469571` both identify this exact SHA and success; the earlier cancelled Delivers run is superseded.

No local builds, tests, probes, fault injection, credential reads or runtime compactions/wakes were performed. Guards and migration changes were source-reviewed; exact-head CI is the execution proof.
